notes: 381 community solutions aligned with Striver A2Z, plus 8 original teaching references for heaps and greedy algorithms. Not affiliated with takeUforward. This snapshot is not a complete copy of the 455-question sheet. Difficulty labels are inferred from source folders, not official ratings. Community implementations are not independently verified. Missing statements, editorials, and complexity are explicitly identified. Hint prompts, taxonomy, and the Two Sum teaching note are original additions.
